meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用你提供的 cmem.ai 连接信息(同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 地址)配置插件,把密钥安全写入配置文件并检查状态。也可把插件重新打包,让配对长期有效。
howto.when: 当你要求设置/配对 claude-mem、连接 cmem 等,或提供 cmem.ai 连接信息(同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 地址)时。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem 配对
say.note: Claude 会向你要 cmem.ai 连接信息。

say.text: 连接 cmem,这是同步令牌和 User ID
say.note: 会提取并安全写入配置。

say.text: 把插件打包成 .plugin 让我重装
say.note: 这样配对才能跨会话保留。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude uses your cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user ID, SyncHub URL) to configure the plugin, writes credentials securely to files, and verifies status. It can also repackage the plugin so pairing survives new sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up/pair claude-mem, connect cmem, set up Cowork cloud sync, or provide cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user ID, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem pairing for me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your cmem.ai Connect details.

say_en.text: Connect cmem with this sync token and user ID.
say_en.note: It will extract and securely store them.

say_en.text: Repackage the plugin as a .plugin file so I can reinstall.
